# Test Design

For the next planned slice only, design test cases before implementation. Include positive, negative, boundary, permissions, validation, timeout, external provider failure, retry, idempotency, concurrency and recovery tests according to risk. Each test gets a stable TEST ID and maps to AC IDs. Specify fixture/data, steps, expected results and evidence. Do not implement feature code. Request approval of the test design.
